dismissed.reason: Withdrawn by the critic. Naming tests after the ticket is a preference, and the Story/TestCase traits keep the link to BUG-16.

upheld.detail: TypedResults.Problem passes the message positionally (it binds to `detail`), while CancelOrderAsync and ShipOrderAsync use the named `detail:` argument. The behaviour is identical.

dismissed.title: Error banner wider than the list it belongs to
dismissed.reason: Withdrawn after verification. The banner reuses the existing .error-message class (app.css:94-100), which has no max-width, and AddWebhook.razor:21 shows errors at the same full width. There is no mockup, so this matches the existing design system.

dismissed.title: Remove buttons have the same accessible name
dismissed.reason: Withdrawn. The story's Outputs require each button to be 'labeled exactly `Remove`'. An aria-label would replace that accessible name, and the button sits in a table row next to its Destination and Token cells.

dismissed.title: 'This webhook no longer exists.' box is much wider than the table
dismissed.reason: Duplicate of UI-1-1 (same element, same frame videos/09/frame-005), and withdrawn. The message uses the existing .error-message style at the app's normal width, and the frame shows the exact text with the list reloaded.
